Replace its realistic crystal, glowing fantasy forest, water, skyline, haze and tiny sparkles completely. Image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for near-black ink, warm-ivory cut paper, coral and electric-cyan accents, large halftone print texture and dynamic angular graphic design; DO NOT copy its interlocking circular rings, waveform centerpiece or radial layout. Create five staggered vertical warm-ivory paper-cut frequency trees on a near-black field: a broad tall central trunk with alternating angular branches made of frequency bars, four simpler flanking trunks, one small coral diamond as the central pulse node, and a single cyan zigzag waveform visibly connecting all five trunks. The tree silhouettes must remain distinct from city buildings or piano keys. Strong graphic silhouette legible at 100px, sparse coral halftone in corners, restrained print grain, quiet near-black lower fifth for later local title overlay. All ages, energetic but no strobe. No realistic water, sky, crystal, vegetation, landscape, ring, platform, character, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark or copied game art.
